content.comment_body: Hello, experts! I'm seeking advice for a home installation setup using three [product_name] devices [article_no] with firmware [version_no]. Two manage blinds and one handles lighting. The programs usually run fine, but the lighting unit's program stops automatically after several hours and returns to the device menu, requiring manual restart. All three [product_name] units are networked as masters, and I use the S7Remote app on my iPhone for network inputs. Does anyone have an idea why this issue occurs? I'm willing to share my network project if it helps. Thanks for the support!

This problem has been acknowledged by [company_name] and specifically affects [product_name] units [article_no] with firmware [version_no] and displays. The issue cannot be fixed. For more details, see: [url]

Thank you for the quick response. When you say there's no fix, does this mean a firmware upgrade won't help? Should I consider returning the devices? Appreciate your input despite the disappointing news.

Firmware updates are not available for these [product_name] units. You may be able to seek a warranty claim. For information about [company_name]'s handling of this, please contact your local representative.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that [product_name] [article_no] with firmware [version_no] and display sometimes stop running their programs after varying durations, bringing up the device menu and needing manual restart, despite initially operating properly. The issue is recognized and linked to a specific hardware and firmware combination; firmware updates cannot resolve it. This undermines device reliability and independence, as the problem can't be addressed by the user.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect these devices to run continuously and autonomously, with any program interruptions fixable via firmware updates or support. Clear solutions or replacement options for such fundamental errors are also desired.
